en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Al Amraky Bin Ali, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his brother<sup>asws</sup> Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who contracted his slave. So he said after having contracted him, ‘Gift me part of it, and I will hasten for you what was in my contract’. Is that permissible?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When it was a gift, so there is no problem, and if he says, ‘Settle from me and I will hasten for you’, so it is not correct’.
